title: Hidden relationships in a document-derived property graph: top-k chunk embeddings and inverse-distance weighting over a dynamically evolving ontology
abstract: arXiv:2609.00387v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models extracting knowledge graphs from text capture only explicitly stated facts, often leaving semantically related entities disconnected across documents. We present an additive, engine-neutral second pass that discovers these latent ties without altering extracted facts. Each document is chunked and embedded once; top-k nearest- neighbor queries across existing chunks yield candidate node pairs via entity membership maps. Candidate pairs are scored using Shepard inverse-distance weighting with a rescaled chord distance metric, avoiding the threshold-collapsing flaw of affine cosine scoring behind a k-NN gate. Un-gated per-pair accumulators form a commutative monoid, ensuring the pipeline is strictly order-independent and scales incrementally without recomputing prior documents. Implemented across FalkorDB, Kinetica, ArangoDB, and Neo4j, our method shows that 768- and 240-dimensional embeddings retain 92% and 72% edge

translated_title: 文档衍生属性图中的隐藏关系：动态演化本体上的top-k数据块嵌入与反距离加权
translated_abstract: 大语言模型从文本中提取知识图谱时只能捕获明确陈述的事实，常常导致跨文档的语义相关实体之间缺乏连接。我们提出了一种可加的、引擎无关的第二遍处理方法，可以在不改变已提取事实的情况下发现这些潜在联系。每个文档只需分块并嵌入一次；通过实体成员映射，对现有数据块进行top-k最近邻查询即可产生候选节点对。候选节点对使用Shepard反距离加权和重新标定的弦距离度量进行评分，避免了在k-NN门控下仿射余弦评分的阈值塌缩缺陷。无门控的逐对累加器构成可交换幺半群，确保整个流水线严格与处理顺序无关，并且可以增量扩展而无需重新计算先前的文档。该方法已在FalkorDB、Kinetica、ArangoDB和Neo4j上实现，结果表明768维和240维的嵌入分别保留了92%和72%的边
tldr: 该论文提出一种引擎无关的二次处理方法，利用top-k数据块嵌入与Shepard反距离加权，在动态演化的知识图谱中发现跨文档的潜在实体关系，并且可增量扩展而无需重新计算已有文档。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an engine-neutral second pass using top-k chunk embeddings and Shepard inverse-distance weighting to discover latent cross-document entity relationships in dynamically evolving knowledge graphs, scaling incrementally without recomputing prior documents.
